objective: Compressed Sensing for Real-Time Detection, Parameter Estimation and DOA of FHSS UAV Signals on Coherent SDR/FPGA Platforms
limitations: Prepared input questions; no live model has produced this plan.

RQ1.topic: What compressed sensing approaches exist for wideband or FHSS signal detection?

RQ2.topic: Which sparse recovery algorithms have demonstrated sufficient complexity for real-time implementation?

RQ3.topic: Which methods estimate carrier frequency, hop timing, duration, sequence and band occupancy jointly or sequentially?

RQ4.topic: Which methods combine sparse sensing with direction-of-arrival estimation?

RQ5.topic: Which approaches support coherent multi-channel receivers?

RQ6.topic: Which approaches have FPGA, SDR, GPU or RFSoC implementations?

RQ7.topic: What are the primary computational and memory bottlenecks?

RQ8.topic: Which prior work specifically targets UAV communication signals?

RQ9.topic: Which work operates near 500-1000 hops/s and under what assumptions?

RQ10.topic: Which scoped scientific gaps remain after the closest prior art is considered?
